name: evals
description: LLM evaluation methodology, eval-suite design, and guided practice around the Claude Code eval runner, distilled from Anthropic's official evaluation guidance: a knowledge router over success criteria, eval design, and grading methods (/evals:methodology); an action skill that interviews for measurable success criteria and scaffolds a graded eval suite for an LLM app or a Claude Code skill (/evals:design); a guided runner that preflights the CLI and the target, prices a suite before it spends, and reads the with-versus-without delta (/evals:plugin-eval); and a static case-file check that spends nothing and makes no model call (/evals:validate).

max_cost_usd.title: Eval run cost ceiling (USD)
max_cost_usd.description: Ceiling /evals:plugin-eval passes to the CLI as --max-cost-usd. It bounds one invocation, not a session's total, and a run that reaches it stops mid-suite with partial results. Raise it for a suite whose estimate exceeds it.

unlimited_cost.title: No cost ceiling
unlimited_cost.description: Drop --max-cost-usd from the invocation so a suite always runs to completion. The estimate is still printed before the run; only the ceiling goes away.

split_policy.title: Train/test split policy
split_policy.description: How eval cases split when a skill or prompt is tuned against them. train-test (the default) splits train and test as the bundled hillclimb guide does; reporting-only also holds back a split that no keep-or-revert decision or final pick reads, used only to report the result.

interval_method.title: Interval method for pass counts
interval_method.description: Interval the noise report puts on the count of cases that pass the threshold. normal (the default) uses the normal approximation; wilson uses the Wilson score interval; jeffreys uses the Jeffreys interval. Score intervals and the with-versus-without difference always use normal.

review_format.title: Case review output format
review_format.description: Format /evals:design renders candidate eval cases in for your approval. markdown (the default) is a table plus one fenced block per case; html is one page with every field escaped.

grader_run_twice.title: Judge-vote agreement report
grader_run_twice.description: When on, /evals:plugin-eval's noise report shows how often the judge votes for each llm grader agreed, read from votes the run already took, at no extra spend.

same_model_warning.title: Same-model judge warning
same_model_warning.description: When on, /evals:plugin-eval's preflight warns when the tested model and the judge model resolve to the same model, and /evals:design repeats the reminder beside the build-eval route.

labeled_grader_check.title: Labeled-set grader check
labeled_grader_check.description: When on, /evals:design checks a grader against a set of cases you label, not only the handful-of-cases agreement check.
